title: calendar month view: the resize-end handle is drawn when the view declares no end-date field, and dragging it PATCHes the unchanged start date (updated_at bumps, update triggers fire)
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, found beside the clauses (records-forms.calendar-interactions), reach: the console calendar, measured twice.
Business reason: on a calendar view that has only a start date (the stock showcase task calendar), every card still shows a resize handle. Dragging it moves nothing but sends a write of the unchanged date, so `updated_at` changes and every record-after-update trigger and flow runs for an edit nobody made (notifications, audit rows, integrations).
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/packages/plugin-calendar/`. QA suggestion only: `area:records`, p3.
Duplicate search: `showResizeHandle` → 0 hits; `calendar resize` → 14 hits and `calendar endDateField` → 18 hits, none about a resize handle without an end field.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. As admin on the stock showcase: `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/calendar` (the view declares `startDateField: due_date` and no `endDateField`).
2. Drag the `[role=separator]` "resize event end" handle of a card ("Build homepage", Nov 12) onto the next day.

Expected: no resize handle when no end field is configured (or a write of the end field only). Actual: `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID {"due_date":"(the unchanged day)"}` → 200; the card stays, no toast, and `updated_at` moves. Reproduced 2 times on two cards.

## Mechanism (suspected)
`ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx` sets `showResizeHandle = !!onEventDrop && isSpanEnd`, independent of an end field; `ObjectCalendar.tsx` `handleEventDropDefault` always patches `startDateField`, and with no `endDateField` the patch is the unchanged start.

QA-source: #29002 · records-forms.calendar-interactions · observed beside the clauses
